blocks.content: This chapter covers both A&N-specific schemes and the way pan-India flagship schemes have been adapted/rolled out in the UT — a recurring current-affairs question type in state/UT-focused exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Development initiatives in the region prioritize island-focused and geography-specific requirements.
Tribal welfare schemes are specifically framed to safeguard and empower local indigenous tribes.
Pan-India flagship schemes are tailored to meet logistical and infrastructural challenges in the A&N context.
A comprehensive disaster management framework is essential for handling island-specific disaster risks.

cells: ₹72,000-crore mega infrastructure project — ICTT, greenfield airport, township, power plant (see Chapter 4 for detail)
Apex body (chaired by the Union Home Minister) overseeing holistic development of identified islands for tourism, fisheries, and infrastructure; A&N's Lieutenant Governor serves as Vice-Chairman
Commissioned 2020; connects Chennai to Port Blair and 9 other major islands with high-speed broadband (see Chapter 4)
Port modernisation and coastal-shipping-linked development at Port Blair and other minor ports under India's national port-led development programme
A&N's marine zone is a key research area for India's Deep Ocean Mission, exploring polymetallic nodules and marine biodiversity
Central scheme to develop select islands (e.g., Smith Island, Long Island) for eco-tourism and adventure tourism under a public-private partnership model

items: Special central assistance and PVTG-specific development funds under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs' PVTG Development scheme, applied to the Great Andamanese, Onge, Jarawa, Sentinelese and Shompen.
Andaman Adim Janjati Vikas Samiti (AAJVS) — the nodal tribal welfare body of the A&N Administration responsible for the welfare, healthcare, and habitat protection of the indigenous tribes.

'Jarawa Policy 2004' — a landmark tribal welfare policy adopted by the A&N Administration prioritising minimum intervention, protection of the Jarawa's autonomy and habitat, and restricting unnecessary outside contact.

Ban on tourist 'human safaris' along the Andaman Trunk Road strengthened via a 2013 Supreme Court directive and 2012 amendment to ANPATR, restricting commercial/tourist vehicular movement through the Jarawa Reserve.

blocks.content: Pan-India Flagship Schemes in A&N Context

items: Swachh Bharat Mission and Swadesh Darshan (tourism circuit scheme) have both been applied to develop A&N's coastal and heritage tourism infrastructure.
PM Gati Shakti and Sagarmala have been invoked in the context of the Great Nicobar transshipment port to integrate it into India's national multi-modal logistics framework.

PM-DevINE and Aspirational Districts-style special-category funding logic (though A&N districts are not formally 'Aspirational Districts') have occasionally been referenced in Parliament debates on island infrastructure gaps.
Ayushman Bharat and the National Health Mission have been extended to A&N with special provisions for reaching remote/tribal populations via mobile medical units.

blocks.content: Given Seismic Zone V status and the 2004 tsunami experience, A&N has one of India's more developed sub-national disaster-management frameworks.

items: Specific focus on PVTG protection measures and tribal welfare schemes in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
Adaptation mechanisms of central flagship programs when implemented in island Union Territories.
Key provisions and emergency response structures within the Disaster Management Framework.
Andaman & Nicobar Islands Disaster Management Authority — chaired by the Lieutenant Governor, coordinates preparedness and response.

Indian Tsunami Early Warning System (ITEWS), operated by the Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS), Hyderabad, was substantially strengthened after 2004 and covers the entire A&N coastline with real-time buoy and seismic monitoring.

The 'Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar' (Disaster Management Award) is an annual UT-level award recognising excellence in disaster-management work, awarded around Netaji's birth anniversary period.
Islands Development Agency (IDA) — Union Home Minister-chaired apex body; A&N LG is Vice-Chairman.
AAJVS (Andaman Adim Janjati Vikas Samiti) is the nodal tribal-welfare body of the UT administration.
Jarawa Policy 2004 + 2012 ANPATR amendment + 2013 SC directive together restrict 'human safaris' on the Andaman Trunk Road.
ITEWS (INCOIS, Hyderabad) provides real-time tsunami early warning coverage for the A&N coastline.
Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar — annual UT disaster-management excellence award.
